text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Mubarak discusses with Lebanese prime minister developments in the peace process and bilateral relations. Hariri tells al-Ahram after the talks that Egypt and Lebanon share the same views on the peace process and that any relatoin between Lebanon and Israel is based on a comprehensive agreement; he says Lebanon agrees with Damascus on the need to link Syrian and Lebanese peace tracks.
- Syrian Foreign Minister Farouk al-Shara delivers message from Syrian President Hafez al-Assad to Mubarak on crisis caused by Israel's intransigent policies.
- Mubarak and Arafat discuss Israel's provocation in East Jerusalem.
- Ministers agree on final wording of early retirement project for public sector workers. Amendments put pension minimum at 12,000 pounds ($3,500) and maximum at 35,000.
- American businessmen say Egypt is the perfect place for investment.
- Police arrest Algerian woman who came to Egypt to revive Jihad group.
- Mubarak in important talks on explosive situation of peace process.
- Dore Gold delivers message to Mubarak from Netanyahu.
- U.N. gives go-ahead to EgyptAir to fly Libyans to pilgrimage in Saudi Arabia.
- Prime Minister Ganzouri says there are no plans for ministerial reshuffle.
- Foreign Minister Moussa to head Egypt's delegation to Islamic summit.
